name: Women's USAF-style mess dress: officer sleeve braid overlay (1/2 in, 2 1/2 in from the sleeve end)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-female. Braid 0.5 in wide, its edge nearest the sleeve end 2.5 in from the sleeve end (cut parallel to the cuff) per CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1; general officers wear 1 1/2 in (separate overlay). Mess dress braid tone: lighter blue taken from the dress's own satin shawl collar (line #2c4a96, band #18306e, edge #0a1740 against the coat #001c52, about 3.6x the coat luminance), not the tonal Class A look, because the tonal braid could not be seen on the mess dress (Doran D37). Drawn as 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)

sleeve_braid.rule: lower edge parallel to the drawn cuff edge and 2.5 in from it (CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1), measured perpendicular to the cuff edge; the ends are cut on the sleeve outline (outer) and on the vertical 9.14 in from the centre line (box x 3.96 in), where the cuff is seen to end in the composed figure (the skirt's edge below it); the two sleeves are mirror images; all in outline inches (x from the centre line, y down from the top of the traced outline)

documented: 1/2 in blue sleeve braid 2.5 in from the end of the sleeve, all officers except generals (4.1.2.1)
assumed: braid colour: not specified as a shade; lighter blue from the dress's satin shawl collar so it can be seen on the coat, Doran D37 (see base-art/braid-art.js)
